main_text.p: עֲלוֹת p. Pistilla, juxta R.Salom. 2.Paral.24.14. Potest & Infinit. Hiphil esse: scribitur enim הָעֲלוֹת Offerendi. Si esset Nomen, articulus ה notaretur cum Kametz. Sensus tamen Vas vel Instrumentum aliquod videtur postulare.
עָלִי m. Pistillum, ab Attollendo, Prov.27.22.

עֲלִיָּה f. Ascensus, Cænaculum, Conclave superius, ad quod Ascenditur: דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה Fores cænaculi, Jud.3.23. Constr. עֲלִיַּת הַשָּׁעַר Cænaculum portæ, 2.Sam.18.33. Aff. וַעֲלִיָּתוֹ Et ascensum ejus, 2.Par.9.4. בַּעֲלִיָּתוֹ In cænaculo suo, 2.Reg.1.2. Plur. וַעֲלִיּוֹת Et cænacula, Jer.22.14. Aff. עֲלִיּוֹתָיו Cænacula excelsa sua, Psalm.104.3.
עֶלְיוֹן m. Excelsus, Supremus, Gen.14.18. Plural. Chald. עֶלְיוֹנִין Excelsi, Dan.7.18. Fœm. הָעֶלְיוֹנָה Summum, Ezech.41.7. Plur. עֶלְיוֹנוֹת Ezech.42.5.
עִלָּאָה m. Chald. Excelsus, Dan.4.14. & 7.25. Juxta Masorethas legendum עִלָּאָה quæ est forma emphatica absoluta עִלַּי vel עִלָּאִי.
עֶלִית f. Superius, Jud.1.15. Plur. עֶלִיּוֹת Superiores, Jos.15. v.19. Masculinum ejus esset עֶלִי.
עֲלִיתָה f. Chald. Cænaculum: Aff. בְּעַלִיתָהּ In cænaculo suo, Dan.6.10.
מַעַל m. Elatio, Elevatio: בְּמַעַל יְדֵיהֶם Cum elatione manuum ipsorum, Neh.8.6.

מֵעַל unde, מִמַּעַל Supra, Supernè, Gen.22.9. 1.Reg.8.23. Cum ה paragogica & accentu in penult. manente, מַעְלָה Supra, de loco & tempore, ut Exod.30.14. Geminatum, מַּעְלָה מַעְלָה Supra Supra, id est, Perquamsupremè, Deut.28.43. לְמַעְלָה Supra, Sursum versus, Ezech.43.15. מִלְמַעְלָה Superne, Gen.6.16.
מַעֲלָה Ascensus, Clivus, Gradus, Suggestum, Excelsior seu Superior locus; בְּמַעֲלָה In ascensum, Neh.12.37.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are copied as far as the scan allows and may be imperfect. Several Hebrew forms, especially the vowel marks and the spacing of the geminated word in the entry on מֵעַל, are uncertain. The printed "Perquam supremè" is run together with "Perquam" and "supremè" as shown on the scan. "Excelsus" in the Chaldee entry was read from a partly blurred line. The Hebrew for "Excelsus" in the entry for עִלָּאָה is not fully legible.
